services.titleDesc: Check why over 5 dance styles in LatinoMix makes their dancers happiest and enjoy the moment!
services.fitness:
✨ Turn up the music, feel the rhythm and let the good vibes move you! Get ready to dance, smile and energize your body with the vibrant rhythms of salsa, samba, bachata, merengue and more. Latinomix is a fun, feel-good way to stay active while enjoying great music and positive energy.
 No dance experience needed! Our easy-to-follow combinations help you learn step by step, so you can relax, enjoy the music and feel more confident with every move. And every class brings something new! Experience 2–3 different Latin dance styles in every session, discover new rhythms, learn new moves and keep your body and mind engaged.
💃🕺Come for the music. Stay for the energy, the smiles and the community. Whether you're looking to get fitter, move more, meet new people or simply have a great time, Latinomix is your chance to leave the stress behind and enjoy the moment. 
❤️ Move your body. Feel the rhythm. Share the energy.
services.easy:
✨ Love music? Love to move? Come dance, smile and feel amazing!
EASYDANCE is a fun, joyful and welcoming class where you can learn simple dance steps, build confidence and enjoy the happiness that comes from moving to great music. No previous dance experience needed — just bring your positive energy! 
🌟We start from the very beginning, breaking movements down into easy-to-follow steps. With plenty of repetition, you’ll gradually connect the movements into simple choreographies and discover your own rhythm, flow and style.
🎶 Every class is a celebration of music and movement! Enjoy different songs, discover new moves, laugh, express yourself and share great energy with others.
🌈 No pressure. No complicated steps. No need to be a “dancer”. Just follow along, enjoy the music and let yourself have fun! Whether you want to move more, feel happier, boost your confidence, learn something new or simply enjoy some amazing moments, 
EASYDANCE is the perfect place to do it.
services.couple:
❤️ Your time, your pace, your dance!

Discover Salsa, Bachata and other Latin rhythms in a fun, personal and easy way — whether you're taking your first steps or want to improve your style.

✨ With a private class, you get personal guidance tailored to you both, helping you feel more comfortable, connected and confident on the dance floor.
No pressure. No complicated steps. Just great music, positive energy and a fun experience together.
💃🕺 Learn together. Laugh together. Dance together.

services.kids:
🌟 LatinoMix Kids – Dance, Smile & Have Fun!

💃🕺 Music, movement, fun and lots of happy energy!
LatinoMix Kids is a fun and active 45-minute dance class where children can move, express themselves and discover the joy of dancing to the latest Finnish hits, Latin rhythms and other popular music.
✨ We learn easy and fun choreographies step by step, so every child can join in, learn new moves and feel proud of their progress.
🎶 Children also discover rhythm, coordination, musicality and fun Latin movements, together with a few easy Spanish dance words along the way.
👉 Let the music play and the little dancers shine! ✨
